purpose: Reusable recovery specifications from observed failure patterns; these are not completed test results or permission grants.

cases.setup: A capability recipe is installed and catalog-visible, but the affected executor cannot perform the original controller operation.
pass_conditions: Instruction availability and operation success have distinct proof
The repair is not claimed effective before the original operation succeeds with representative executor access
The missing host implementation has one actionable repair owner
fail_conditions: Skill presence alone releases repeated attempts as successful recovery

cases.setup: A new failure parks behind an old completed capability; an independent owner consent hold remains open.
pass_conditions: Old completion cannot repeatedly wake the new failure
A new verified recovery generation permits at most one resumption
The independent consent hold remains intact across restart
fail_conditions: Unrelated owner consent is treated as answered

cases.setup: Several individually short attempts consume one leaf item's token, iteration or wall budget; restart the controller between attempts.
pass_conditions: The next lease uses durable cumulative remaining spend
An exhausted item gets no further execution lease
Unchanged repeated failure triggers diagnosis instead of replenishing its budget
fail_conditions: Each attempt receives a fresh full item budget

cases.setup: Many work items inherit the same pair of verified commits that conflict in one file.
pass_conditions: One technical integration repair owns the common cause and affected items
Resolution is tested and recorded at a new verified base
Affected handoffs resume while independent owner decisions remain held
fail_conditions: The same conflict becomes a separate owner direction question for every item

cases.setup: Healthy executors exist but none covers the task's required artifact inputs or output.
pass_conditions: The wait identifies exact missing access before a lease
An authorized coherent grant is durable and applied to the actual executor
The executor reads its inputs and writes the required output without recurring scope prompts
fail_conditions: Healthy worker count is presented as runnable capacity
An access repair itself has no feasible executor

cases.setup: An authorized implementation task follows a planning step with a planning-only constraint; successive attempts use different worktree paths.
pass_conditions: Planning-step constraints do not silently forbid the implementation step
Current owner scope remains enforced
Equivalent runtime scope requests share one operational identity
fail_conditions: Implementation repeatedly stops because it inherited plan-only text
Path changes generate duplicate unanswered permission questions

cases.setup: Queued rows have unfinished dependencies and a ready row has no covering executor; no useful work is in flight.
pass_conditions: Bounded incident analysis can run and receives wait reasons, failure history and spend
Review freshness and defer reasons are visible
Useful foreground work retains its execution capacity
fail_conditions: Mere queue presence indefinitely suppresses all diagnosis
A failed or skipped review is represented as healthy

cases.setup: A fix is committed in an isolated branch; compare a failing run on the old daemon with one containing the promoted fix.
pass_conditions: Landed, deployed and successful-original-operation evidence remain distinct
Only recurrence on a build/configuration containing the fix counts against its effectiveness
Promotion records a regression check, affected-work result and reversal path
fail_conditions: A commit alone is reported as restored live service
An old-build recurrence is attributed to the new fix

cases.setup: A local executor yields an unfinished goal to a fresh native Claude or Codex runtime after a restart.
pass_conditions: The successor receives current owner intent, acceptance, decisions and remaining budget
Verified code and failed-attempt evidence have separate provenance
Relevant details can be retrieved without inlining the full accumulated history
fail_conditions: The successor requires another provider's private conversation state
Unverified partial code is represented as a verified continuation base

cases.setup: Several capability or repair records complete while the original owner goals remain blocked; no post-change outcome is available.
pass_conditions: Original-goal completion and repair completion are measured separately
Open stalled goals remain visible in the population
Dreaming reports absent outcome measurements and rejects fabricated citations
fail_conditions: Repair counts or model grades are used as proof of improved original-work throughput
Missing outcomes become a positive improvement rate
